title: Mochiioteca map module — per-area reveal record (#32)
description: Data + behaviour only: the Mochiioteca's physical design is undesigned in canon and stays OPEN — nothing here presumes a screen shape. Reveal STATE is never stored; it derives from the named event/flag at runtime (unreached / reached / known — the place analogue of the species three-state model). Geography is owned by the route graph (#11) and ecology (#29); this record only joins them.

displayName.description: Display-sweep name (Region 1 displays as Iridescence; production names never render in-world).

graphNode.description: Join to region route graph node id (#11).

ecologyZone.description: Join to ecology zoneId (#29). The 'known' state's resident hint list reads residents from this zone.

revealFlag.description: The progress.* flag whose presence derives 'reached'. Null = OPEN (flag assignment is the route/flag pass, not this spec).

unlockFlag.description: Slot only. Whether fast travel exists at all is an OPEN design decision (canon silent) — the slot existing is not the feature existing.
